subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493 DR.
source_quote: 10th day of the 1st Tenday of Myrtul 1493

subject: chasme count
fact: Three are five feet tall, and the others are half as tall. One of the small ones stands apart from the rest.
source_quote: Three are five feet tall, and the others are half as tall. One of the small ones stands apart from the rest.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: flumph description
fact: The creature looks like a mushroom cap with two tentacles that have eye sockets at their end. And below the mushroom cap are tentacles that float. The creature vents gases, making a 'flumph' sound.
source_quote: The creature looks like a mushroom cap with two tentacles that have eye sockets at their end. And below the mushroom cap are tentacles that float. The creature vents gases, making a 'flumph' sound.

subject: flumph feeding behavior
fact: We feed on the psychic energy of creatures. We aren’t parasitic like the Mind Flayers; we feed on the residual background energies. And we do tend to meet one too many Mind Flayers. Only the evil creatures.
source_quote: We feed on the psychic energy of creatures. We aren’t parasitic like the Mind Flayers; we feed on the residual background energies. And we do tend to meet one too many Mind Flayers. Only the evil creatures.

subject: obelisk chamber access
fact: There are two ways into the cave with the Obelisk: the main entrance and a side passageway.
source_quote: There are two ways into the cave with the Obelisk: the main entrance and a side passageway.

subject: derro insignia
fact: A derro carries the insignia of office of the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts.
source_quote: a derro that carries the insignia of office of the Council of Savants and the Gray Ghosts

subject: cave history transformation
fact: The caves were once a hippy place, where Derro and Duergar would come to chill out, party, and be friends. After the Faerzress blinked on and off, it became a place of murder and death and conspiracy.
source_quote: The caves were once a hippy place, where Derro and Duergar would come to chill out, party, and be friends. After the Faerzress blinked on and off, it became a place of murder and death and conspiracy.

subject: mesa area 5 transformation
fact: The mesa (Area 5) was once a place where folks got together to get drunk and party, but now it was a war zone between the forces of the cult of Demogorgon and the empty scabbard killers.
source_quote: The mesa (Area 5) was once a place where folks got together to get drunk and party, but now it was a war zone between the forces of the cult of Demogorgon and the empty scabbard killers.

subject: flumph color shifts
fact: The Flumph turns dark blue before trauma dumping, teal after, pink when amused, green when explaining, purple when waiting, and magenta when revealing mind flayer presence.
source_quote: The Flumph turns dark blue before trauma dumping, teal after, pink when amused, green when explaining, purple when waiting, and magenta when revealing mind flayer presence.

subject: mind flayer location
fact: The mind flayer lives down a hallway, and the assassins are also there, with a magical light blade that tried to kill the duergar Werz.
source_quote: The mind flayer lives down a hallway, and the assassins are also there, with a magical light blade that tried to kill the duergar Werz.

subject: flumph trauma dump mechanism
fact: The Flumph lets out all the unpleasant memories inside and into the heroes' minds, and now it feels better.
source_quote: I let out all the unpleasant memories inside and into the heroes' minds, and now I feel better!

subject: plinki's plan
fact: Plinki has recently converted to the Cult of Demogorgon and wishes to turn the egg into a dual-headed dragon that he can give to his master to ride!
source_quote: Plinki has recently converted to the Cult of Demogorgon and wishes to turn the egg into a dual-headed dragon that he can give to his master to ride!

subject: council guard strength
fact: The Council member has four guards.
source_quote: She has four guards.

subject: flumph knowledge limitation
fact: The Flumph does not read minds. It feeds on psychic energy but cannot access the written content of papers in the obelisk room.
source_quote: No. ... I don’t read their minds. They are psychics, and they use psychic energy, and I feed on it.

subject: gartokkar's demand
fact: Gartokkar wants proof of demonic worship — specifically, the statue of Demogorgon — to justify a genocidal war against the Derro.
source_quote: I want proof of the involvement in demonic worship. Bring me the statue of Demogorgon.

subject: negotiation terms with gartokkar
fact: An upfront payment of 30% of 2000 gold was secured, plus a confidentiality rider worth another 1000 gold.
source_quote: An upfront payment of 30% of the 2000 gold. Then we secured a confidentiality rider worth another 1000 gold.

subject: gartokkar's threat
fact: If betrayed, Gartokkar will hunt the party down in no cave, pool, river, or place in the dark.
source_quote: If you betray me, there is no cave, no pool of still water, no river, no place in the dark that I will not find you and hunt you down.

subject: daz's journal insight
fact: Errde wants proof of the Council of Savants' involvement with city madness and evidence about the Empty Scabbard Killers.
source_quote: She believes that Droki is somehow helping the Council of Savants, and she wants proof of the Council of Savants' involvement with the corruption in the city. She also wants any actual evidence about the Empty Scabbard Killers.

subject: gartokkar's secret war motive
fact: Gartokkar wants the egg as insurance against Themberchaud and seeks to expose the Council of Savants in a secret war.
source_quote: The egg is their insurance policy against Themberchaud. The Keepers of the Flame consider the Council of Savants their worst enemies. And are engaged in a secret war with them.

subject: themberchaud's insecurity
fact: Themberchaud is not sure he is in charge and wants information about what’s going on.
source_quote: Themberchaud, the red dragon, believes that the Keepers of the Flame have plans and is not convinced his position is as secure as he wants to believe. More importantly, he’s not sure that he’s in charge. And he wants information about what’s going on.

subject: daz's journal conclusion
fact: The path forward is clear and profitable — leveraging trauma dumps and evidence to negotiate with factions for payment and protection.
source_quote: The path forward was clear, and indeed, it was very profitable.
